text: {"summary":"A node must be removed from service while preserving live traffic. The classifier reports a traffic_spike, but the provided documentation does not describe traffic spikes as a cause for node removal.","likely_cause":"traffic_spike (as reported by the classifier)","confidence":"medium","next_action":"1. Verify the node is already in a shutdown or power‑off state. 2. Add the taint node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service (NoExecute or NoSchedule) to force‑delete pods without matching tolerations and trigger immediate volume detach. 3. Alternatively, use kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets <node> to evict pods, then power down the node. 4. After the node is recovered or replaced, manually remove the out-of-service taint or run kubectl uncordon <node> to resume scheduling."}
